crossRefs.note: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who…
When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels…
They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh…
Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman…
I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man…
A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in…
Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men, who will be able…
Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

translations.web: However there was no accounting made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand; for they dealt faithfully.”
translations.bsb: But they need not account for the money put into their hands, since they work with integrity.”
translations.kjv: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
translations.asv: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand; for they dealt faithfully.
